findings.description: Ambiguous patch-surface.md path; the remote_session content (24 refs, invariants 54-59) is in the codex WRAPPER doc codex/docs/implementation/patch-surface.md (= docs/implementation/patch-surface.md relative to the codex submodule root), NOT the nested external/repos/codex-patched/docs/... copy (0 refs). Verified by grep.
findings.resolution: Disambiguated all patch-surface references to the wrapper doc, explicitly excluding the nested copy.

findings.description: Q2 left open about a new AppEvent round-trip even though the /remote on arm can drive onboard inline and reuse the existing AppEvent::SetRemoteSession (maybe_attach already returns immediately + works on a background task). Extra AppEvent is avoidable upstream-canonical surface.
findings.resolution: Decided Q2: drive inline on a background task + reuse existing AppEvent::SetRemoteSession; new variant only as last resort if add_info_message surfacing is insufficient. Captured in Approach + marked Q2 DECIDED.

findings.description: Plan worktree's codex/ submodule is not initialized, so codex paths are absent locally. Implementation needs an explicit preflight: git submodule update --init --recursive + a codex submodule worktree before editing.
findings.resolution: Added a Prerequisites (impl-time) note to Implementation Strategy: init submodules + create a codex submodule worktree per packages/happy-cli/AGENTS.md; do not edit the codex submodule inside the plan worktree.

findings.description: Q2 unresolved but determines the core /remote on control flow; leaving it open risks an autonomous agent creating duplicate attach paths or blocking the TUI while polling the device flow.
findings.resolution: Q2 decided (see F-002): inline + background task, single attach path via existing AppEvent::SetRemoteSession, explicit 'exactly one attach path' constraint.

findings.description: SessionPlaneSupervisor::stop() underspecified: the Node daemon is a shared machine singleton; if codex stops/restarts a daemon it did not own it disrupts existing happy-cli/mobile sessions. Need an ownership rule.
findings.resolution: Added explicit OWNERSHIP RULE: ensure_running() is start-if-absent + health only; never stop/restart a daemon codex did not start (codex-owned-child-only, else deferred to Phase 2). Added to supervisor design, US-004 ACs, Risk Areas, and In Scope.

findings.description: Plan omits the required codex submodule ship mechanics: codex-side commit in a submodule worktree + push to the codex remote, then a SEPARATE codexu parent commit bumping the codex/ pointer. Repo workflow requirement.
findings.resolution: Added a 'Ship mechanics' subsection to Implementation Strategy documenting the two-commit + pointer-bump discipline and SANDBOX PATCH registration (plan-only; impl member executes).

findings.description: access.key 'chmod after atomic write' may leave a too-permissive transient temp file (default umask) before chmod. For a secret, create the temp file itself at 0o600, or verify write_json_atomically already does.
findings.resolution: Changed the M1 requirement to secure-CREATE (OpenOptions.mode(0o600) on the temp file + final file), not chmod-after-write, scoped to access.key. Updated Technical Constraints + US-001 AC.

findings.description: Daemon readiness contract should explicitly cover machine.json + listener ports (and capability for happy-cli). Mirroring only port checks risks accepting a half-ready daemon.
findings.resolution: Specified readiness = machine.json with valid tunnelPort + TCP probe of tunnelPort (the tunnel listener codex attaches to, no auth header per auth.rs:84-86); clarified the loopback capability is happy-cli-internal and NOT required for codex readiness (optional loopbackPort probe as a fully-bound signal). Updated supervisor design + US-004 AC.

findings.sectionRef: Open Questions Q2 / Preliminary Story Decomposition
findings.description: US-003 depends on the chosen async TUI surfacing path from Q2, but Q2 left open; resolve before US-002/US-003 so AttachError, onboarding progress, and final attach errors share one event/message path.
findings.resolution: Resolved with F-002/F-004 (Q2 decided): single inline + background-task path reusing AppEvent::SetRemoteSession; US-002 error plumbing precedes US-003 in the serial ordering.

findings.description: ACs do not require a test for 'happy-cli missing from PATH / no Phase-1 daemon' even though Q1 says it is central. Add an AC that /remote on after self-onboard reports a categorized NoDaemon when no daemon binary is available.
findings.resolution: Added an explicit NoDaemon AC (plan Acceptance Criteria + US-004) exercised with an injected spawner/PATH-probe fake: after successful self-onboard, no daemon available -> categorized NoDaemon, no hang, no silent fallback.

findings.description: The 'wipe ~/.happy' AC is imprecise for autonomous verification and risks mutating a developer's real credentials. Use a temp HAPPY_HOME_DIR fixture instead.
findings.resolution: Replaced wipe-~/.happy with a temp HAPPY_HOME_DIR fixture (happy_home_dir() respects $HAPPY_HOME_DIR) in the plan Acceptance Criteria + US-001/US-003 ACs; the live clean-machine spike remains impl-time only.
